briefs.text: Strikes cut refining to a 20-year low
Abiy accuses Eritrea of arming foes
Search called off for missing miners
AirAsia delays pay; PH unit cuts jobs
India, EU back Ukraine peace deal
Trump would welcome Putin at G20
US share of car imports now 40%
Two held over Clan del Golfo ties

date_check: Left out, because they happened on other days: Taiwan's nine-in-one local elections are held Sat 28 Nov · Spain votes Sun 29 Nov · Indonesia's vice-president resigned Thu 26 Nov · Bangkok's Bangchak refinery fire was Thu 26 Nov · Norse Atlantic halted its flights Thu 26 Nov. Every story above happened, or was first reported, on Friday 27 November 2026 (UTC).

panels.headline: US jet disables second Iran-blockade runner
panels.summary: CENTCOM says a jet hit the stern of the Palau-flagged Pacific Archer after it ran the blockade. Iran claims commandos retook two seized tankers — unconfirmed.

panels.headline: EU summit ends with no deal on budget or Ukraine loan
panels.summary: Leaders leave the €1.6tn 2028–34 budget and a €45bn Ukraine loan unresolved. Macron sets a year-end deadline; talks resume on 17–18 December.

panels.headline: Zelensky: Trump's Putin 'friendship' is strange
panels.summary: In a BBC interview Zelensky questions the label as Kyiv offers a Black Sea ceasefire. Trump answers that he wants a deal, not a feud.

panels.headline: Storms leave 100,000s dark
panels.summary: Storms hit both US coasts over the holiday. Hundreds of thousands of homes were still dark on Friday.

panels.headline: Congo Ebola cases pass 12,000
panels.summary: Cases pass 12,000 in the second-largest outbreak on record. Fighting in Ituri has trapped response teams.

panels.headline: Cult leader convicted over 123 more deaths
panels.summary: A Kenyan court finds Paul Mackenzie guilty of manslaughter. Hundreds more deaths were already laid to his doomsday cult.

panels.headline: Israeli strikes kill four in Gaza
panels.summary: Israeli attacks kill at least four Palestinians on Friday. The son of Hamas's chief reportedly survived.

panels.headline: Police free 164 from cyber-fraud gang
panels.summary: Delhi police rescue 92 Indonesians and 72 Malaysians. They were confined in a suburb and forced to run online scams.

panels.headline: Final count: NZ bloc one seat short
panels.summary: Final results leave PM Luxon's bloc one seat below a majority. He turns to the centrist Opportunity Party for a deal.

panels.headline: Spain's leaders clash in final debate
panels.summary: Sánchez's Socialists trail the conservative PP in polls. Far-right Vox eyes a kingmaker role on Sunday.

panels.headline: China sets defence-education plan
panels.summary: Defence education expands to students and gig workers. Lessons link to military recruitment campaigns.

panels.headline: Lula names Trabuco Cappi finance chief
panels.summary: Lula picks Bradesco chairman Trabuco Cappi for the job. The presidential office announced the choice on Thursday.

panels.headline: Myanmar chief refuses ICJ order
panels.summary: Min Aung Hlaing says some ICJ measures will not be carried out. The order covers protection of the Rohingya.

US October goods trade deficit; imports a record
